issues.where: late night through frost, especially 30.8–39.4 s; also visible across cuts 3 and 4
issues.what: The hero bud visibly floats above the stalk. The strip of sky between them persists as the bud swells, making the head read as a separate moving object rather than growth at the stem tip.
issues.fix: Anchor the base of the bud to the stem tip throughout the swell and rotation, and keep that attachment continuous through f0899–0900 and f1199–1200.

issues.what: The opening head has less top clearance and its disk is already broadly exposed; the target holds a lower, less-open silhouette with the disk still mostly screened by petals.
issues.fix: Give the head more top clearance at this key and delay disk exposure until after it, preserving the later full-bloom key.

issues.what: The night key has a pin-sized bud on an exposed tip, and the frost key leaves a long bare run of stem below the bud. Both targets show a fuller crown with the upper leaves clustered much closer to the head.
issues.fix: Bring the night bud to its target screen size sooner and reposition and scale the upper leaf tiers to fill out the crowns at both keys without introducing a jump at the night-to-frost cut.

issues.where: pair 7, left edge and field behind the hero; also visible at pair 6
issues.what: The bloom close-up loses the large cropped left-edge foliage that frames the target, and the background flower faces in pair 7 compete in scale with the hero more than they do in the target.
issues.fix: Block in the left-edge foreground mass and reduce the screen size of nearby background heads while retaining the hero framing and the later two-plant reveal.
